! exec metagente check empty_handler.ag
stderr 'nothing under it'

! exec metagente check stray_otherwise.ag
stderr '`otherwise` must come right after an `if`'

! exec metagente check extra_tokens.ag
stderr 'did not expect'

! exec metagente check unknown_tool.ag
stderr 'did you mean `tool file`\?'

# the last message, like all the others, shows nothing of how the interpreter works inside
! stderr 'panic|goroutine|\.go:|runtime\.'

  tool env
